summary: Implemented IDN-02 group management end to end in the backend: added group registry and membership persistence, created the additive group_members migration, exposed group create/add-member/list-members/remove-member HTTP handlers, enforced idempotent add-member semantics and missing-group/user mappings, and wired GROUP-assignee claim authorization into task completion so active group members can complete assigned tasks without mutating the assignment. Validation passed with zig build, zig build test, and zig build migrate against the test PostgreSQL database.

tests_run.name: zig build
tests_run.detail: Backend compiled successfully after the group-management changes and task completion authorization update.

tests_run.name: zig build test
tests_run.detail: Unit and integration test build passed with the new IDN-02 route and service tests included.

tests_run.name: zig build migrate
tests_run.detail: Applied migration 018_identity_group_members.sql successfully to the test PostgreSQL database using BPM_DB_URL.

issues_found.description: The migration runner expects BPM_DB_URL, so validation needed the test database URL to be provided under that variable rather than BPM_TEST_DB_URL.
